item.title: Kansas foster care bill aims to reduce school disruption after placement changes
item.description: BY MAYA SMITHKansas Reflector TOPEKA — A House bill would require school districts to transfer records of children in foster care within no more than two business days to provide stability in their education. House Bill 2320 would shift the responsibility for transferring records from the Department for Children and Families to school districts, with […]

item.title: ASKING ERIC: Aunt is disinvited from wedding ceremony, but still expected at reception
item.description: Dear Eric: My sister’s daughter is getting married in the fall. My 20-year-old daughter has not been invited because it is “adults only.” This upsets both of us because she is close to her cousin.

item.title: MURPHY’S LAW: Not a fan of traveling in ‘back seats’ of a plane
item.description: I generally don’t mind flying once I get past security, but last week’s trip to Arizona changed my mind a little.

item.title: KDOT seeking comment on STIP amendment
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT) requests comments on an amendment to the Federal Fiscal Year 2026-29 Statewide Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) document.

item.title: Commerce reopens tax credit opportunities for nonprofits, healthcare entities
item.description: TOPEKA – Lieutenant Governor and Secretary of Commerce David Toland has announced the latest round of the Community Service Program (CSP) Tax Credits, making $4.14 million in state tax credits available for donors to qualified projects.

item.title: USDA opens continuous CRP signup; additional enrollment periods set for spring
item.description: Signup is now underway for producers and landowners interested in enrolling acreage in the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Continuous Conservation Reserve Program (CRP), with the current enrollment period running through March 20.

item.title: SENIOR SHOWCASE: Variety of activities, services available at Senior Center
item.description: The Senior Center’s Thrift Shop, “Do Overs” is open every Thursday from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1-4 p.m. Open to all ages! Located inside the Senior Center.
